annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents Rapido Run as an opportunity to join through an inviter using an ETH startup amount for claimed unlimited or passive earnings. It connects recruiting partners, buying or owning packages, upgrading and filling matrix slots with commissions, redirected payments and projected returns. Although the material is described as educational and the figures as projections, it still shows a financial solicitation and participation flow; completed payments, realized returns and external operation are not established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The described earning plan places invited partners beneath participants, routes sales proceeds through participant and upline positions, and makes commissions conditional on owning packages or slots. This is a recruitment and tiered-matrix mechanism, not merely a one-level referral link.
